THE FIRST $AUVEN UTILITY

Proof of a holding, attached to an agent.

A token holder can create a signed record showing that a verified linked wallet held $AUVEN at a particular Robinhood Chain block. The record belongs to an agent in that holder's workspace.

HOW IT WORKS / 01

Three steps. One checkable record.

Nothing is transferred or locked. The balance check runs on the server using the live token contract.

01
◇

Link your wallet.

Sign in with Privy and link the EVM wallet that holds $AUVEN. Only wallets verified on your account can be used.

02
⌁

Read the balance.

AUVEN checks the $AUVEN ERC-20 contract on Robinhood Chain mainnet at a specific block. A positive balance is required.

03
▧

Sign the evidence.

Choose a registered agent. AUVEN signs the wallet, token, amount, block, and agent ID with ML-DSA-65. Export it from Proofs.

PRODUCT UTILITY / 02

One token. A practical role in the product.

Holder attestations are available first. The other mechanics are being designed; they have no live thresholds, prices, or automatic benefits yet.

01 / HOLDER ATTESTATIONLIVE

Prove a holding.

Turn a verified wallet balance into a post-quantum signed snapshot linked to your agent.

Wallet → onchain read → signed proof
02 / HOLDER BENEFITSIN DESIGN

Extend capacity.

We are designing token-based usage allowances for supported agent requests. Thresholds and limits will be published before activation.

Balance → eligibility → allowance
03 / TOKEN PAYMENTSIN DESIGN

Pay for usage.

We are designing an option to pay for defined AUVEN services with $AUVEN. Pricing and settlement rules are not set yet.

Quote → onchain payment → credited service
BURN MECHANISM / IN DESIGN

A measurable token flow.

We are evaluating a burn tied to eligible token-paid usage. Before it goes live, we will define the share, contract method, and public way to verify each burn onchain. No automatic burn is active in AUVEN today.

Service payment→Defined burn share→Onchain receipt
POST-QUANTUM SIGNED / 03

A snapshot that can
stand on its own.

Verify the exported signature without trusting the dashboard. If you choose to publish, AUVEN writes a commitment to its proof registry on Robinhood Chain mainnet.
